status: DOCUMENTED (verbatim from the feature-set dropdowns on the docs page)

metrics.name: Kafka Server - Purgatory Produce Size
metrics.description: Requests waiting in the produce purgatory.

metrics.name: Kafka Server - Purgatory Fetch Size
metrics.description: Requests waiting in the fetch purgatory.

metrics.name: Kafka Connect - Requests
metrics.description: The average number of requests sent per second.

metrics.name: Kafka Connect - Outgoing byte rate
metrics.description: The average number of outgoing bytes sent per second to all servers.

metrics.name: Kafka Connect - Request size
metrics.description: The average size of all requests in the window.

metrics.name: Kafka Connect - Incoming byte rate
metrics.description: Bytes/second read off all sockets.

metrics.name: Active link count
metrics.description: Total number of links in an active state.

metrics.name: Active mirror count
metrics.description: Total number of active (healthy) mirror topics.

metrics.name: Cluster link max lag
metrics.description: Maximum lag in messages between the replicas on the destination cluster and the leader replica on the source cluster.

metrics.name: Fetched bytes per second
metrics.description: Rate at which data is fetched from the source cluster. Indicates amount of throughput in bytes per second on the cluster link.

metrics.name: Fetched throttle time
metrics.description: Gives throttle times for the Cluster Linking fetchers. May indicate increases in lag on the cluster link due to throttling/quotas being enforced.

metrics.name: Active task count
metrics.description: Monitor the state of link level tasks.

metrics.name: Failed reverse connection count
metrics.description: Total count of reverse connections that failed for this cluster link. Only available for outbound connections.

metrics.name: Authentication problems
metrics.description: Unavailable links due to authentication.

metrics.name: Unavailable link (by reason)
metrics.description: Unavailable links due to authentication.

metrics.name: Controller reverse connection count
metrics.description: Number of persistent reverse connections for this link between the local broker and the remote link coordinator.

metrics.name: Controller reverse connection count
metrics.description: Admin request processing time.

metrics.name: Background thread count
metrics.description: Background thread active usage.

metrics.name: Kafka Log - Log flush 95th percentile
metrics.description: Log flush rate and time in milliseconds.

metrics.name: Kafka Log - Log flush mean time
metrics.description: Log flush rate and time in milliseconds.

metrics.name: Kafka Log - Log end offset
metrics.description: The offset of the next message that will be appended to the log, by topic and partition.

metrics.name: Kafka Server - Consumer group lag offsets
metrics.description: The difference between the last offset stored by the broker and the last committed offset for a specific consumer group name, client ID, member ID, partition ID, topic name, and group protocol. Confluent Platform only.

metrics.name: Kafka Broker - Incoming byte rate
metrics.description: The rate at which data sent from producers is consumed by the broker.

metrics.name: Kafka Broker - Mirror topic bytes in rate
metrics.description: The rate at which mirror bytes are received, by topic.

metrics.name: Kafka Broker - Outgoing byte rate
metrics.description: The rate at which data sent from other brokers is consumed by the follower broker.

metrics.name: Kafka Broker - Messages in rate
metrics.description: The rate at which individual messages are consumed by the broker.

metrics.name: Kafka Broker - Follower fetch requests rate
metrics.description: The follower fetch request rate for the broker.

metrics.name: Kafka Broker - Produce message conversions rate
metrics.description: The rate at which produce messages are converted, by topic.

metrics.name: Kafka Broker - Partitions
metrics.description: The number of partitions in the broker.

metrics.name: Kafka Broker - Under replicated partitions
metrics.description: The number of partitions that have not been fully replicated in the follower replicas.

metrics.name: Kafka Broker - Under minimum in-sync replica partitions
metrics.description: The number of partitions whose in-sync replicas count is less than minIsr.

metrics.name: Kafka Broker - Produce request rate
metrics.description: The produce request rate per second.

metrics.name: Kafka Broker - Fetch request rate
metrics.description: The fetch request rate per second.

metrics.name: Kafka Broker - Failed produce requests
metrics.description: The produce request rate for requests that failed.

metrics.name: Kafka Broker - Failed fetch requests
metrics.description: The fetch request rate for requests that failed.

metrics.name: Kafka Server - Max follower lag
metrics.description: The maximum lag between the time that messages are received by the leader replica and by the follower replicas.

metrics.name: Kafka Server - Current follower lag
metrics.description: The lag in number of messages per follower replica.

metrics.name: Kafka Connector - Status
metrics.description: Equals 1 if the status is running, 0 otherwise.

metrics.name: Kafka Connector - Task status
metrics.description: Equals 1 if the status is running, 0 otherwise.

metrics.name: Kafka Connector - Task pause ratio
metrics.description: The fraction of time this task has spent in the pause state.

metrics.name: Kafka Connector - Task running ratio
metrics.description: The fraction of time this task has spent in the running state.

metrics.name: Kafka Connector - Task success ratio
metrics.description: The average percentage of this task's offset commit attempts that succeeded.

metrics.name: Kafka Connector - Task commit time (max)
metrics.description: The maximum time in milliseconds taken by this task to commit offsets.

metrics.name: Kafka Connector - Task failure ratio
metrics.description: The maximum time in milliseconds taken by this task to commit offsets.

metrics.name: Kafka Connector - Task commit time (avg)
metrics.description: The average time in milliseconds taken by this task to commit offsets.

metrics.name: Kafka Connector - Task batch size (max)
metrics.description: The maximum size of the batches processed by the connector.

metrics.name: Kafka Connector - Task batch size (avg)
metrics.description: The average size of the batches processed by the connector.

metrics.name: Kafka Consumer - Consumer lag
metrics.description: The latest lag of the partition.

metrics.name: Kafka Consumer - Consumer lag average
metrics.description: The average lag of the partition.

metrics.name: Kafka Consumer - Consumer lag maximum
metrics.description: The max lag of the partition.

metrics.name: Kafka Partition - Observer replicas count
metrics.description: The number of observer replicas for a partition in a Confluent Multi-Region Cluster (MRC), by topic and partition.

metrics.name: Kafka Partition - Caught up replicas count
metrics.description: The number of replicas considered caught up to the topic partition leader. This may be greater than the ISR size, as observers may be caught up but not part of the ISR. By topic and partition.

metrics.name: Kafka Partition - Is not caught up
metrics.description: Reports 1 (true) if not all replicas are considered caught up to the partition leader, otherwise 0. By topic and partition.

metrics.name: Kafka Partition - Observers in ISR count
metrics.description: The number of observers that are currently in the in-sync replicas (ISR) list for a partition in a Confluent Multi-Region Cluster (MRC), by topic and partition.

metrics.name: Last applied record offset
metrics.description: The offset of the last record from the cluster metadata partition that was applied by the broker.

metrics.name: Last applied record timestamp
metrics.description: The timestamp of the last record from the cluster metadata partition that was applied by the broker.

metrics.name: Last applied record lag
metrics.description: The difference between now and the timestamp of the last record from the cluster metadata partition that was applied by the broker.

metrics.name: Metadata load error count
metrics.description: The number of errors encountered by the BrokerMetadataListener while loading the metadata log and generating a new MetadataDelta based on it.

metrics.name: Metadata apply error count
metrics.description: The number of errors encountered by the BrokerMetadataPublisher while applying a new MetadataImage based on the latest MetadataDelta.

metrics.name: Records appended rate
metrics.description: The average number of records appended per sec by the leader of the raft quorum.

metrics.name: Commit latency (avg)
metrics.description: The average time in milliseconds to commit an entry in the raft log.

metrics.name: Commit latency (max)
metrics.description: The maximum time in milliseconds to commit an entry in the raft log.

metrics.name: Record fetch rate
metrics.description: The average number of records fetched from the leader of the raft quorum.

metrics.name: Log end epoch
metrics.description: The current raft log end epoch.

metrics.name: Log end offset
metrics.description: The current raft log end offset.

metrics.name: Current leader ID
metrics.description: The current quorum leader's id; -1 indicates unknown.

metrics.name: Kafka Network - Produce requests per second
metrics.description: The total number of requests made for produce per second

metrics.name: Kafka Network - FetchConsumer requests per second
metrics.description: The total number of requests made for fetch consumer per second

metrics.name: Kafka Network - FetchFollower requests per second
metrics.description: The total number of requests made for fetch follower per second

metrics.name: Kafka Network - Total time per Produce request
metrics.description: Total time, in milliseconds, spent processing requests, for produce.

metrics.name: Kafka Network - Total time per FetchConsumer request
metrics.description: Total time, in milliseconds, spent processing requests, for fetch consumer.

metrics.name: Kafka Network - Total time per FetchFollower request
metrics.description: Total time, in milliseconds, spent processing requests, for pfetch follower.

metrics.name: Kafka Network - Request queue size
metrics.description: Size of the request queue.

metrics.name: Kafka Network - Response queue size
metrics.description: Size of the response queue.

metrics.name: Kafka Network - Network processor average idle percent
metrics.description: The average fraction of time the network processor threads are idle.

metrics.name: Kafka Server - ZooKeeper disconnects
metrics.description: A meter that provides the number of recent ZooKeeper client disconnects.

metrics.name: Kafka Server - ZooKeeper expires
metrics.description: The number of ZooKeeper sessions that have expired.

metrics.name: Kafka Server - Zookeeper Active Connections
metrics.description: The number of currently open connections to the broker.

metrics.name: Kafka Server - Handler Pool Idle Percent Rate
metrics.description: The average fraction of time the request handler threads are idle. Values are between 0 meaning all resources are used and 1 meaning all resources are available.

metrics.name: Kafka Controller - Leader election rate
metrics.description: The broker leader election rate and latency in milliseconds. This is non-zero when there are broker failures.

metrics.name: Kafka Controller - Unclean election rate
metrics.description: The unclean broker leader election rate. Should be 0.

metrics.name: Kafka Server - Leader count
metrics.description: The number of replicas for which this broker is the leader.

metrics.name: Kafka Consumer - Requests
metrics.description: The average number of requests sent per second for a node.

metrics.name: Kafka Consumer - Request size
metrics.description: The average size of all requests in the window.

metrics.name: Kafka Consumer - Incoming byte rate
metrics.description: Bytes/second read off all sockets.

metrics.name: Kafka Consumer - Outgoing byte rate
metrics.description: The average number of outgoing bytes sent per second to all servers.

metrics.name: Kafka Consumer - Request latency
metrics.description: The average request latency in ms for a node.

metrics.name: Kafka Consumer - Assigned Partitions
metrics.description: The number of partitions currently assigned to the consumer.

metrics.name: Kafka Consumer - Messages consumed rate
metrics.description: The average number of records consumed per second for a topic.

metrics.name: Kafka Consumer - Bytes consumed rate
metrics.description: The average number of bytes consumed per second for a topic.

metrics.name: Kafka Consumer - Messages consumed rate total
metrics.description: The average number of records consumed per second.

metrics.name: Kafka Consumer - Bytes consumed rate total
metrics.description: The average number of bytes consumed per second.

metrics.name: Kafka Consumer - Fetch latency
metrics.description: The average time taken for a fetch request.

metrics.name: Kafka Consumer - Fetch throttle time avg
metrics.description: The average time in milliseconds a fetch request was throttled by the broker.

metrics.name: Kafka Producer - Incoming byte rate
metrics.description: The average number of responses received per second for a node.

metrics.name: Kafka Producer - Outgoing byte rate
metrics.description: The average number of outgoing bytes sent per second to all servers.

metrics.name: Kafka Producer - I/O Wait time
metrics.description: The average length of time the I/O thread spent waiting for a socket ready for reads or writes in nanoseconds.

metrics.name: Kafka Producer - Response rate
metrics.description: Responses received sent per second.

metrics.name: Kafka Producer - Request latency
metrics.description: The average request latency in ms.

metrics.name: Kafka Producer - Compression rate
metrics.description: The average compression rate of record batches, defined as the average ratio of the compressed batch size over the uncompressed size.

metrics.name: Kafka Producer - Request size
metrics.description: The average size of all requests in the window.

metrics.name: Kafka Producer - Requests
metrics.description: The average number of requests sent per second.

metrics.name: Kafka Producer - Produce throttle time avg
metrics.description: The average time in milliseconds a request was throttled by the broker.

metrics.name: Kafka Producer - Byte rate
metrics.description: The average number of bytes sent per second for a topic.

metrics.name: Kafka Producer - Compression rate
metrics.description: The average compression rate of record batches for a topic, defined as the average ratio of the compressed batch size over the uncompressed size.

metrics.name: Kafka Producer - Failed Requests Rate
metrics.description: The average per-second number of record sends that resulted in errors for a topic.

metrics.name: Kafka Producer - Requests Sent Rate
metrics.description: The average number of records sent per second for a topic.

metrics.name: Kafka Controller - Offline partitions
metrics.description: The number of partitions that don't have an active leader and are therefore not writable or readable.

metrics.name: Kafka Controller - Active cluster controllers
metrics.description: Indicates whether the broker is the controller broker.

metrics.name: Kafka Server - Disk Read Rate
metrics.description: The total number of bytes read by the broker process, including reads from all disks. The total doesn't include reads from page cache. Available only on Linux-based systems.

metrics.name: Kafka Server - Disk Write Rate
metrics.description: The total number of bytes written by the broker process, including writes from all disks. Available only on Linux-based systems.
